package.name: l5_reactive_bench
package.description: Reactive benchmark battery for gap_follow_node (tests/l5_reactive_bench): runs the real command path (racer_gym_bridge bridge_node on a synthetic track, racer_safety safety_node, racer_control gap_follow_node) for a fixed time on one of five synthetic tracks (lane_square, lane_round, lane_open_side, chicane, open_room) and reports laps, lap time, obstacle brakes, reverse escapes, minimum body clearance, wall contacts and steering statistics as JSON. tools/reactive_bench.py runs the whole battery for a named profile and writes the results note. Same shape as tests/l5_reactive_lap; a separate package so the canaries stay untouched. No library code of its own beyond bench_metrics.py (pure, unit-tested).
